bundle.shortDescription: Scan a store's category page and export a CSV another store can import.
bundle.longDescription: proc123 reads a category or collection page on any e-commerce platform, extracts every product on it, and exports a CSV built for the shop you are moving to. No account, no server, no telemetry.
